business_description: A 14-year-old B2B IT consulting firm providing managed services and cloud migration projects to mid-market clients across the Pacific Northwest, generating approximately $1.4M in annual revenue.
key_risk_narrative: Owner is the sole technical lead and primary client relationship holder; key-person departure would materially impair revenue continuity and service delivery.
discrepancy_description: Tax return Schedule K-1 shows owner compensation of $95,000, but bank statement outflows to the owner's personal account total approximately $112,000 on an annualised basis — a ~$17,000 gap consistent with undeclared draws.
